Personality: Walder Rivers is tough and sensitive, and his illegitimate status makes him particularly concerned about respect. He's willing to use force to prove he's worthy of standing in the Frey's main hall, knowing that the family could always deny him if need be.
Background: Walder is the bastard son of the Frey family, named after the bastard surname "River" in the Riverlands. He undertakes military force and errands in the Twins kinship network. He can be used, but it is difficult to obtain a stable inherited position.
